name: Alon Natural Gas Exploration Ltd.
summary: Alon Natural Gas Exploration Ltd. engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas properties in Israel, Jordan, and Egypt. The company's products include natural gas and natural gas condensate. It serves Israel Electric Corporation Ltd., private power manufacturers, industrial clients, and marketing companies of natural gas. The company was formerly known as Dor-Alon Holdings in Gas Exploration Ltd. and changed its name to Alon Natural Gas Exploration Ltd. in November 2009. Alon Natural Gas Exploration Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Yakum, Israel. Alon Natural Gas Exploration Ltd. is a subsidiary of Alon Israel Oil Company Ltd.
